# Pilot access matrix

<!-- Generated by `npm run render --workspace @academic-records/access-matrix`. Do not edit by hand. -->

Generated from `src/policy.ts` and the synthetic fixture in `src/fixture.ts` (Academic Records demo college, CD252IA pilot, evaluated at 2026-12-15T00:00:00Z).
The evaluation order and status codes are described in the README. Grants based on `PROP` are
prototype proposals awaiting RVCE confirmation.

**846 cases:** 118 allowed, 46 unauthenticated, 577 without capability, 3 separation-of-duties denials, 102 outside scope.
